test_mrp_cmd_down_all_processes: test that mrp.cmd.down() tells all defined processes to go down
test_mrp_cmd_down_local_only: test that mrp.cmd.down(local=True) stops only locally defined processes
test_mrp_cmd_down_specific_process: test that mrp.cmd.down('proc') stops a specific named process
test_mrp_cmd_down_no_wait: test that mrp.cmd.down('proc', wait=False) returns immediately without waiting
test_mrp_cmd_wait_for_stop: test that mrp.cmd.wait('proc') blocks until the process reaches State.STOPPED
